name: Vessel of Lost Echoes
summary: +1 Power, and on every tap of the bearer a d6 that may give back 1 HP.

face.name: Vessel of Lost Echoes

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: The Entity it is assigned to has +1 Power. Each time that Entity becomes tapped, roll a d6: on 4 or more you gain 1 HP.

face.flavor: Inside, the voice of whoever lost it still speaks.
